Pre-split order history: a by-id GET /v0/bead/{id} (humaHandleBeadGet) of an order-tracking id minted in a rig's work ledger before the split resolves it there, a row written before the orders class moved to its binding. Seen here through T7e's equivalence table calling resolveBeadOwner, which T7e.2 split so a close resolves its owner in the request's epoch (resolveBeadOwnerIn).
Declared S4 debt under beads.RelicRead (see reviewedMarkers): a scope store read for rows that belong in the class binding, kept for pre-split copies.

Relic, read strict on purpose: the fresh /orders/check event cursor reads every OrderHistory leg unmarked, as main did (T7d.2 keeps gate sensitivity, plan 4.2), so a relocated city's scope leg is charged when it holds a pre-split order-tracking copy. T7f reconciles the cursor with the dispatcher's OrderRuns legs.
